app.title: ThrottleWatch
app.storageDegradedDescription: Readings keep being taken in memory and are not lost; saving is retried automatically every minute. Check your free disk space.

dashboard.coverageDegradedDescription: Advanced access stopped responding; the session continues with level B/C signals.
dashboard.advancedUpgradable: An older version of the advanced-access driver is installed; updating it improves coverage.

screens.notAvailable: This view will be available when the collector and history are ready.

settings.closeActionDescription: Choose whether the app exits or stays in the tray.
settings.closeActionUndecided: You will be asked the first time you close the window.
settings.firstCloseTitle: What should happen when you close?
settings.firstCloseDescription: You can exit ThrottleWatch or keep monitoring in the tray. You can change this choice in Settings.
settings.firstCloseTrayNote: Monitoring will continue in the background.
settings.firstCloseSettingsHint: You can change this choice in Settings → General.
settings.startOnLoginDescription: Start ThrottleWatch when you sign in to Windows.
settings.startHiddenDescription: Continue monitoring without opening the window.
settings.trayRequired: Enable background monitoring to use this option.
settings.notificationsRequired: Enable notifications to be alerted when a run finishes.
settings.corruptBackupNotice: At startup, the previous database could not be opened and was set aside without deleting it ({file}). You can export it before you forget about it.
settings.closeBlockedExportDescription: Closing now cancels the export or import in progress. A half-written file is discarded, never left incomplete.
settings.closeBlockedDownloadDescription: Closing now interrupts the download. Nothing is lost: nothing is saved until the signature is checked.
settings.closeBlockedInstallDescription: ThrottleWatch is installing. Wait for it to finish before closing.

accessNote.upgradable: An older version of the advanced-access driver is installed; updating it improves coverage.
accessNote.denied: Advanced access is off or blocked; the app continues with reduced coverage.
accessNote.error: Advanced access stopped responding; repair it to recover full coverage.

settings.technicalSummaryNote: It contains no identifiers or raw log lines.
settings.operationFailed: The operation could not be completed.
settings.partialOperation: The operation completed with some items still pending.
settings.detailedLoggingActive: Active for 24 hours or until restart.
settings.updateCheckNowDisabled: Turn on automatic update checks to be able to check.
settings.updateAvailableDescription: It is downloaded only when you ask and installed only when you confirm.
settings.updateVerifiedDescription: Installing will close ThrottleWatch and reopen it updated.
settings.updateErrorNetwork: Could not reach the update server. Try again later.
settings.updateErrorSignature: The update does not match its signature and was discarded. Nothing was installed.
settings.updateErrorNoKey: This build cannot verify updates yet.
settings.updateErrorInstall: The update could not be installed. You can retry.
settings.updateErrorGeneric: The update could not be completed.

updateBlocked.guided_test: Wait until the guided diagnostic ends.
updateBlocked.data_operation: Wait until the data deletion ends.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.emptyDescription: Passive and guided sessions will appear here when saved data is available.
sessions.errorDescription: History is unavailable right now. You can try again.
sessions.deleteDescription: Its samples, events and report will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
sessions.reevaluatedHeadline: With today's rules, this session would be classified differently
sessions.reevaluatedNote: This reevaluation is informational only: it never replaces the original report, and it is not saved.
sessions.reevaluatedNoNote: With today's rules, this session would be classified the same as in the original report.
sessions.reevaluatedUnavailable: This session could not be recalculated with today's rules.
sessions.reportObserved: The report summarizes the signals and events recorded during the session.
sessions.reportNoImpactReason: This session does not contain enough inputs to quantify impact.
sessions.reportMethod: Report frozen from samples and events persisted locally.
sessions.reportMethodMissing: No method is available for this session.
sessions.reportNoReport: This session does not have a saved report yet.
sessions.reportIncomplete: The session did not finish normally.
sessions.reportProvisional: This result is provisional while the session is still running.
sessions.reportUnavailable: The session detail could not be loaded.

slide1.title: Understand your CPU
slide1.body: ThrottleWatch observes heat, power and performance without changing your equipment.

slide2.title: What it observes
slide2.body: Temperature, load, active frequency and package power, with short explanations for technical terms.

slide3.title: What it can conclude
slide3.body: It distinguishes high temperature, thermal limits, power limits and insufficient data.

slide4.title: Privacy and choices
slide4.body: Everything runs locally. You control language, theme, background operation and notifications.

slide5.title: This computer
slide5.body: Passive detection starts here and shows what this equipment can reliably explain.

coverage.completeDescription: The available signals support the full diagnostic path.
coverage.partialDescription: The app remains usable and will explain which conclusions need more signals.

access.upgradable: An older version of the advanced-access driver is installed; updating it improves coverage.
access.denied: Advanced access is unavailable; the app will continue at a lower coverage level.

lowLevel.title: More reliable sensor coverage
lowLevel.body: This version makes advanced access explicit and keeps the main interface usable when it is unavailable.

guided.title: Guided diagnostic
guided.readyBody: The diagnostic uses a generator with no hardware writes.
guided.introBody: Measures sustained performance under the equipment's current conditions.
guided.disclaimer: This is not a certified benchmark; it compares this equipment with itself.
guided.restDescription: Stabilizes the equipment before loading it.
guided.cancelledDescription: The session stopped and is recorded as incomplete.
guided.safetyStopDescription: The test stopped after a safety condition was detected.
guided.sensorLostDescription: The required coverage could not be maintained.
guided.closeDescription: The test must stop before the window can close.

analysis.noHistoryDescription: Complete a session to analyze it.
analysis.selectEvidence: Select an event or range to see the evidence.
analysis.anonymizeDescription: Hides equipment identifiers in the export.

cpu.title: CPU
cpu.waitingDescription: Cores remain visible even when no valid reading is available.

thermal_confirmed.title: Possible persistent thermal limit
thermal_confirmed.body: The CPU is running below its guaranteed frequency and the machine reports temperature as the cause. Open ThrottleWatch to see the evidence.

power_limited.title: Possible persistent power limit
power_limited.body: The CPU is running below its guaranteed frequency because of a power limit. Open ThrottleWatch to see the evidence.

platform_limited.title: Possible limit imposed by the machine
platform_limited.body: The machine seems to limit the CPU below its guaranteed frequency. Open ThrottleWatch to see the evidence.

collector_lost.title: ThrottleWatch stopped receiving data
collector_lost.body: The sensor collector is not responding. Monitoring will resume if it becomes available again.

guided_finished.title: Guided diagnostic finished
guided_finished.body: The diagnostic has finished. Open ThrottleWatch to see the report.

update_available.title: A new ThrottleWatch version is available
update_available.body: Version {version} is available. Nothing is downloaded until you ask for it in Settings.
